summary: Frontend-only testing of 2 new features (live camera + product compare). Found 1 CRITICAL syntax error (fixed), 1 CRITICAL missing feature (Compare CTA button not wired in JSX), and 1 HIGH issue (web camera click silent because Alert.alert is no-op on react-native-web). Photo-picker split into Caméra/Galerie works visually on web. Gallery picker testID retained. Backend analyze endpoint still works end-to-end (verified by creating a second analysis and receiving full response with score 98, decision, ingredients).

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: Missing 'Comparer 2 produits' CTA button. State `compareOpen` and `<Compare visible={compareOpen}/>` modal are declared, but NO TouchableOpacity in the JSX calls setCompareOpen(true). Style `compareCta`/`compareCtaText` is defined (lines 461-462) but never used. Users cannot open the Compare modal. Verified with 2 history items — no button rendered.

FIXED by test agent: Lines 508-511 contained duplicated/corrupted style entries after StyleSheet was already closed, causing Metro SyntaxError 'Unexpected token (508:12)'. Bundle was failing on every request. Removed garbage lines; file is now 507 lines and builds cleanly.

HIGH: On web, clicking the 'Caméra' button produces NO visible feedback. `Alert.alert('Caméra', 'La caméra live est disponible sur mobile...')` is a no-op on react-native-web (no window.alert fallback fires; captured 0 dialog events in Playwright). The camera modal is correctly blocked from opening, but user is left confused with nothing happening. Replace Alert.alert with `window.alert(...)` inside `Platform.OS === 'web'` branch, or use a custom in-app toast/modal.

issues: Caméra + Galerie buttons render side-by-side with good spacing (gap=sm), dashed borders, 44pt+ touch targets — visually correct.

react_native_issues.issue: Expo warns: expo-camera@55.0.16 installed but expected ~17.0.10 for current Expo SDK. May cause native runtime issues on mobile. Run `npx expo install expo-camera` to align versions.

action_items: Add the 'Comparer 2 produits' CTA TouchableOpacity in products.tsx JSX — visible only when `history.length >= 2`. Example placement: right below the quick-scan-card (~line 180). Use existing styles.compareCta / compareCtaText. Must call setCompareOpen(true) and carry testID='compare-cta' (or 'open-compare-btn').
Replace Alert.alert in the web branch of openCamera() with window.alert('La caméra live est disponible sur mobile. Utilisez la galerie sur le web.') so users get visible feedback on web.
Align expo-camera version with current Expo SDK via `npx expo install expo-camera` to avoid native mismatches.
Investigate how trailing garbage was appended to products.tsx (likely a bad search_replace). Add a lint/typecheck step to catch this pre-save.
critical_code_review_comments: products.tsx: setCompareOpen is declared but never set to true anywhere — feature scaffolded but not wired.
products.tsx previously had corrupted trailing content causing SyntaxError — indicates no pre-commit lint.
LiveCamera.tsx looks correct: uses expo-camera CameraView, handles permissions, testIDs on shutter/flip/close, base64 capture with quality 0.6.
Compare.tsx is well-structured: side-by-side cards, picker modal, winnerBanner, testIDs (pick-a, pick-b, slot-a, slot-b, pick-item-{id}, close-compare-btn). Ready to use IF the opener is added.

success_rate.frontend: 60% — 4 of 7 requested features work: (1) Caméra+Galerie side-by-side ✅, (2) Galerie still works ✅, (3) Compose+analyze still works ✅, (4) Compare modal component exists ✅. Failing: (5) Compare CTA button missing ❌, (6) Compare modal cannot be opened end-to-end ❌, (7) Web camera alert invisible ❌.

seed_data_creation: Created 1 new analysis during testing: 'TEST Sérum Doux' (score 98, 'À utiliser') for demo@skincare.app. Left in history to facilitate retest of Compare feature once CTA is added. Can be deleted via trash icon or DELETE /api/products/{id}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo account now has 2 products in history ('TEST Sérum Doux' and 'UI Test Crème'), sufficient to exercise the Compare CTA once E1 adds it. After E1 fix, test: (1) Compare CTA visible only when history>=2, (2) Tap opens Compare modal (close-compare-btn, pick-a/pick-b slots), (3) Pick 2 items → side-by-side score/decision/compat/flags/risks/justifications render, (4) winnerBanner shows product with higher score. Expected testID for CTA: compare-cta.
rca_of_issue: RCA: The Compare feature was only partially integrated. `import Compare` and `<Compare/>` modal were added with `compareOpen` state, but the TouchableOpacity that toggles compareOpen was never inserted into the JSX tree — likely lost during a prior edit that also left syntax garbage at EOF. Reproduction: Login demo@skincare.app → Produits tab with ≥2 history items → no 'Comparer 2 produits' button visible. Mitigation (for E1): add `{history.length >= 2 && <TouchableOpacity testID='compare-cta' style={styles.compareCta} onPress={() => setCompareOpen(true)}><Ionicons name='git-compare-outline' size={20} color={colors.secondary}/><Text style={styles.compareCtaText}>Comparer 2 produits</Text></TouchableOpacity>}` between the quick-scan-card and the Historique section.
